auditor.name: SHWETA JAIN & CO LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: 1) Closing Inventory of Rs. 9.28 Crore - lack of item-wise quantitative details, supporting valuation workings, and management representation; 2) Trade Receivables of Rs. 48.23 Crore including overdue receivables of Rs. 20.97 Crore - insufficient evidence on recoverability; 3) Bank Balance Confirmation of Rs. 28.17 Lakh - direct confirmations not available; 4) Trade Payables of Rs. 21.27 Crore - no payments to certain parties, inadequate explanation. Emphasis of Matter: Non-provision for gratuity for year ended 31st March 2026, non-compliance with Accounting Standard-15.
